## Rust — dash-sdk, dpp, drive, rs-dapi-client

> This is a major release. The two hard-breaking changes are `Signer` → async (§dpp) and the `Query<T>` bound loosening (§sdk). All other changes are additive (shielded pool, platform wallet, document history, count queries).

| Keyword | Pkg | Δ | Change | Migration | Ref |
|---------|-----|---|--------|-----------|-----|
| `Signer::sign` | dpp | ± | Both `sign` and `sign_create_witness` are now `async fn`. Trait gains `Send` bound. | Add `.await` at every call site. Implementors must be `Send + Sync + Debug`. Blanket impl in `Signer for &T` mirrors the change. | [PR:3492] |
| `ValueConvertible` | dpp | ± | Lifetime `'a` removed; trait now requires `DeserializeOwned` instead of `Deserialize<'a>`. | Remove `'a` from any generic bound on `ValueConvertible`. Replace `Deserialize<'_>` bounds with `DeserializeOwned`. | [PR:3492] |
| `Query<T>` | dash-sdk | ± | Bound changed from `Query<T: TransportRequest + Mockable>` to `Query<T: Mockable>` — `TransportRequest` is no longer a bound on `T`. | Re-check `impl Query<_>` sites; the relaxed bound is backward-compatible but may change inference. | [PR:3492] |
| `InternalSdkCache` | dash-sdk | ± | `InternalSdkCache` (public) replaced by `pub(crate) NonceCache` with LRU eviction. `DEFAULT_IDENTITY_NONCE_STALE_TIME_S` and `StalenessInSeconds`/`LastQueryTimestamp` type aliases removed. | Remove any direct construction or field access of `InternalSdkCache`; use the SDK builder — `NonceCache` is internal. | [PR:3111] |
| `AsyncError` | dash-sdk | ± | Moved to the new `dash-async` crate; re-exported as `pub use dash_async::{block_on, AsyncError}` from dash-sdk root. | No source change needed (re-exported at same path). Dependency tree may change. | [PR:3492] |
| `AddressKey` type alias | dash-sdk | − | `pub type AddressKey = Vec<u8>` removed; replaced by `pub trait AddressToBytes`. | Replace `AddressKey` with the concrete address type (`Vec<u8>`) or implement `AddressToBytes`. | [PR:3482] |
| `AddressSyncResult` | dash-sdk | ± | Struct is now generic: `AddressSyncResult<Tag, Address>`. Fields `found`/`absent` use `(Tag, Address)` keys instead of `(AddressIndex, AddressKey)`. New fields: `new_sync_height`, `new_sync_timestamp`, `last_known_recent_block`, `recent_proof`. | Update all destructuring or field access on `AddressSyncResult`. The generic params carry the address type. | [PR:3482] [PR:3531] |
| `AddressSyncConfig` | dash-sdk | ± | New field `full_rescan_after_time_s: u64` added. `AddressSyncMetrics` gains `compacted_queries`, `recent_queries`, `recent_entries_returned`, `compacted_entries_returned`. | Struct-update patterns (`..Default::default()`) are safe; direct construction must add the new field. | [PR:3531] |
| `platform_wallet` re-export | dash-sdk | − | `pub use platform_wallet` removed from dash-sdk root. `platform_wallet` is now a separate crate (`rs-platform-wallet`). | Add `rs-platform-wallet` as a direct dependency if you use `PlatformWallet` types. | [PR:2855] [PR:3531] |
| `grovedb_commitment_tree` re-export | dash-sdk | + | `pub use grovedb_commitment_tree` added at dash-sdk root (shielded-pool commitment tree types). | Use directly via `dash_sdk::grovedb_commitment_tree::*` or add the crate as a dep. | [PR:3732] |
| `ShieldedFacade` | dash-sdk | + | New `pub mod shielded` in dash-sdk; exports `ShieldFunds`, `ShieldFromAssetLock`, `TransferShielded`, `WithdrawShielded`, `UnshieldFunds` traits; sync primitives `sync_shielded_notes`, `sync_shielded_notes_stream`, `ShieldedSyncConfig`, `ShieldedSyncResult`, `DecryptedNote`, `ShieldedChunkBatch`. | Opt-in; no migration needed. Enable via `sdk.shielded()` facade or individual trait impls. | [PR:3230] [PR:3756] [PR:3816] |
| `IdentityCreateFromShieldedPool` | dash-sdk | + | New trait: create identities funded from the Orchard shielded pool (state transition + proof flow). | New capability; additive. | [PR:3816] |
| `ShieldedMemo` | dpp | + | New enum `ShieldedMemo` and constant `DASH_MEMO_SIZE = 36` (+ `MEMO_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 32`) for attaching memos to shielded transfers. | New capability; additive. | [PR:3836] |
| `Signer::sign` | dpp | + | Added blanket `async impl Signer for &T` delegating to `T`. Lets `&sdk` be passed where `Signer` is expected. | Additive; useful if you hold a reference. | [PR:3492] |
| `DocumentHistoryQuery` | dash-sdk | + | New type + `pub use` from `documents::document_history_query`. Fetch historical revisions of a document. | New capability; additive. | [PR:3725] |
| `QuerySettings` | dash-sdk | + | New `pub mod query_settings` + `pub struct QuerySettings<'a>`. Allows per-call override of timeout, retry, and network settings on any `Fetch` call. | Optional; pass `QuerySettings::default()` to use prior behaviour, or customise per call. | [PR:3483] |
| `DocumentCountQuery` | dash-sdk | + | New count-query types `DocumentCountQuery` / `DocumentSplitCountQuery` with methods: `document_count`, `document_split_counts`, `document_split_averages`, `document_sum`, `document_average`, `document_split_sums`. Bounded, verifiable aggregate queries. | New capability; additive. | [PR:3435] [PR:3623] [PR:3661] |
| `TokenPreProgrammedDistributionsQuery` | dash-sdk | + | Query pre-programmed token distribution schedule. | New capability; additive. | [PR:3246] |
| `ContactRequestInput` | dash-sdk | + | New DashPay contact-request types `ContactRequestInput` / `SendContactRequestInput` + `pub mod dashpay`. Exported from dash-sdk root. | New capability; additive. | [PR:3531] |
| `OrchardAddress` | dpp | + | New type wrapping `grovedb_commitment_tree::PaymentAddress` for Orchard shielded addresses. Constants: `ORCHARD_ADDRESS_SIZE = 43`, `ORCHARD_DIVERSIFIER_SIZE = 11`, `ORCHARD_PKD_SIZE = 32`. | New capability; additive. | [PR:3228] |
| `OrchardProver` | dpp | + | New trait `OrchardProver` + associated note types (`SpendableNote`, `SerializedBundle`, `SerializedAction`, `OrchardBundleParams`). Required for building shielded state transitions. | Additive. Implementing `OrchardProver` unlocks shielded transitions. | [PR:3816] [PR:3793] |
| `DocumentTypeV2` | dpp | + | New `DocumentTypeV2` struct and associated getter/setter traits (`DocumentTypeV2Getters`). Parallel to V1; use for contracts opting into `$schema: v1`. | Additive; existing V1 paths unchanged. | [PR:3531] |
| `IndexCountability` | dpp | + | New `pub enum IndexCountability` controlling whether an index supports `COUNT` queries. | Additive; default preserves V1 behaviour. | [PR:3623] |
| `JsonConvertible` | dpp | + | New trait replacing direct `serde_json::Value` conversions. | Additive. | [PR:3531] |
| `IdentityPlatformValueConversionMethodsV0` | dpp | ± | Lifetime `'a` removed from trait bound. | See `ValueConvertible` migration above. | [PR:3492] |
| `rs-platform-wallet` | rs-platform-wallet | + | New top-level crate with `PlatformWallet`, `PlatformAddress`, `KeyWallet`, `AssetLockManager`, `IdentityManager`. Manages Dash addresses, asset-lock proofs, identity top-ups, and shielded send/receive. | New crate; add `rs-platform-wallet` as a dependency to use wallet primitives. | [PR:2855] [PR:3531] [PR:3671] |
